test_tokenize: test the tokenize function to split text into tokens handling apostrophes and special characters
test_detokenize: test the detokenize function to rejoin a list of tokens back into a single string
test_split_words_on_whitespace: test the split_words_on_whitespace function to separate words and their surrounding whitespace
test_rejoin_words_and_whitespace: test the rejoin_words_and_whitespace function to reconstruct original text from words and whitespace lists
run_utils_test: run the UtilsTest unittest suite to verify all text augmentation utility functions work correctly
